subject: [PATCH v5 12/15] selftests/nfsd: exercise listener_set request validation

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch adds regression tests for the NFSD_CMD_LISTENER_SET checks in the nfsd_netlink_listener code. The tests cover various invalid listener_set requests, including bad transport names, missing addresses, and malformed entries. The tests use kselftest_harness.h to run in their own network namespace and mount namespace, and they do not create any services or register with rpcbind. The patch also updates the MAINTAINERS file and adds a new directory for nfsd selftests.
